2120835231745737072.en_summary: $BP and $PBR: BP is in talks with Petrobras to sell a stake in the Bumerangue oil block off Brazil, its biggest discovery in 25 years. Negotiations are ongoing and a deal may not materialize. (Bloomberg)
2120835231745737072.zh_summary: $BP與$PBR：BP正與Petrobras商談出售其巴西近海Bumerangue油田區塊的股權，這是其25年來最大的發現。談判正在進行，交易可能無法達成。（彭博）

2120834195672998189.en_summary: T1 Energy ($TE) Q3'26 earnings: Revenue $196.6M (est. $273M, -7% YoY), EPS -$0.14 (est. -$0.11), gross margin 8.5%. Raises FY26 G1_Dallas production guide to 4.0-4.2GW from 3.1-4.2GW; FY27 guide 5.3GW. Over 1.58GW offtake signed, more than 3.5GW of 2027 capacity under contract. Cash $137.0M, Section 45X tax credits $155.3M generated. G2_Austin financing negotiating comprehensive debt solution, non-binding LOI for Nordic Data Center to monetize Giga Arctic asset.
2120834195672998189.zh_summary: T1 Energy（$TE）2026年第三季業績：營收1.966億美元（預期2.73億美元，年減7%），每股虧損0.14美元（預期虧損0.11美元），毛利率8.5%。上調2026財年G1_Dallas產能指引至4.0-4.2GW（原3.1-4.2GW）；2027財年指引5.3GW。已簽署超過1.58GW承購合約，2027年超過3.5GW產能已簽約。現金1.37億美元，產生第45X節稅額1.553億美元。G2_Austin融資正談判綜合債務方案，北歐數據中心簽非約束性意向書以變現Giga Arctic資產。

2120833058870026330.en_summary: $NVDA: Board reportedly weighing Jensen Huang's future amid ongoing independent investigation. Retaining Huang preserves strategic continuity; removing him could create leadership uncertainty and trigger broader volatility across AI trade. Short-term: increased selling pressure and price swings. Long-term strengths: CUDA ecosystem, GPU dominance, AI infrastructure demand. Impacts sentiment on $AMD, $AVGO, $MRVL.
2120833058870026330.zh_summary: $NVDA：報導指董事會正因獨立調查進行中而權衡Jensen Huang的未來。留任Huang可維持戰略連續性；撤換則可能造成領導不確定性並引發AI交易更廣泛波動。短期：拋壓增加及價格大幅波動。長期優勢：CUDA生態系統、GPU主導地位、AI基礎設施需求。影響$AMD、$AVGO、$MRVL情緒。

2120832033228476685.en_summary: Jokes aside, at the end of the day we still need GPUs to power this AI revolution. $NVDA will eventually come out of this and everything will be back to normal.
2120832033228476685.zh_summary: 玩笑話不談，終究仍需要GPU來推動這場AI革命。$NVDA最終會走出這個困境，一切將恢復正常。

2120830622214033846.en_summary: GS Desk: Semis are now up nearly 20% from the local lows, even more impressive given limited participation from $NVDA. Plenty of debate if one should rotate back into high-beta or stay patient under the view that AI volatility is here to stay.
2120830622214033846.zh_summary: 高盛交易台：半導體股已從局部低點上漲近20%，在$NVDA參與有限的情況下更令人印象深刻。有不少討論是否應輪動回高Beta，或在AI波動將持續的觀點下保持耐心。
